biotools.summary: SignalingProfiler 2.0 is a computational tool that integrates proteogenomic data with prior knowledge causal networks to draw mechanistic hypotheses on signaling events impacting cellular phenotypes. The tool accelerates the integration and interpretation of multi-omics data and is freely accessible.
